mapper.select: SELECT f.id, left(f.session_id::text, 8) AS session_key, f.message_id, f.reason, f.detail::text AS detail, f.reviewed, f.reviewed_by, f.reviewed_at, f.review_comment, f.review_comment_ciphertext, f.review_comment_key_id, f.review_comment_encryption_version, f.created_at, s.scenario_id, sc.title AS scenario_title, s.current_node_id FROM chat_failure f JOIN chat_session s ON s.id = f.session_id JOIN scenario sc ON sc.id = s.scenario_id WHERE f.session_id = #{sessionId}::uuid ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_failure SET reviewed = true, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = now(), review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_comment_ciphertext = #{reviewCommentCiphertext}, review_comment_key_id = #{reviewCommentKeyId}, review_comment_encryption_version = #{reviewCommentEncryptionVersion} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, review_comment AS plaintext, review_comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, review_comment_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_failure WHERE review_comment_ciphertext IS NULL AND review_comment IS NOT NULL AND review_comment != '' AND review_comment != '[encrypted]' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, review_comment AS plaintext, review_comment_ciphertext AS ciphertext, review_comment_key_id AS key_id FROM chat_failure WHERE review_comment_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_key_id IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_key_id != #{activeKeyId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
